# Drayker General Forum

> Drayker General Forum brings the public issues and replies of every public draykerdk repository, and the pull requests merged into each repository's main branch, into one reading surface. Discussions remain connected to their source repositories, where replies and decisions are recorded.

## Canonical routes

- [Forum index](https://forum.drayker.org/): every public thread, with search and filters by part of the system, label and status.
- [Thread pages](https://forum.drayker.org/t/dfmp/1/): one page per issue at /t/<repository>/<number>/, with the full conversation. The federation's assembly reports (daf pull requests titled Assembly YYYY-MM) also have pages, while open and after merge.
- [Start a thread](https://forum.drayker.org/new/): route a proposal, question, idea or report to its owning repository.
- [Decisions](https://forum.drayker.org/decisions/): the pull requests merged into each repository's main branch, newest first. Direct changes by the founding steward, and older merges into review branches, are in each repository's history.
- [Routing](https://forum.drayker.org/routing/): where each subject belongs, and every repository the forum reads.
- [About](https://forum.drayker.org/about/): how the forum reads GitHub and where publishing happens.

## Data and feeds

- [forum.json](https://forum.drayker.org/data/forum.json): threads, decisions and repositories from the last update.
- Thread files at https://forum.drayker.org/data/t/<repository>/<number>.json: one thread with all its replies.
- [New threads feed](https://forum.drayker.org/feed.xml) and [decisions feed](https://forum.drayker.org/decisions/feed.xml) (Atom).

## Source model

- Every thread has a canonical forum reading URL and an owning GitHub issue URL.
- A scheduled workflow (set to every 15 minutes; GitHub may delay scheduled runs) reads GitHub; the site is republished when something changed.
- Publishing, replies, edit history and moderation remain on GitHub.
- Prefer the source issue for exact status and the forum URL for a stable public reading surface.

## Crawling

Public threads may be indexed and quoted with attribution. The sitemap is at https://forum.drayker.org/sitemap.xml.
